notes.title: Forsaken Valley DEVLOG: Version 0.0.10
notes.notes:
Hello, Divine Tribe! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539919/8b11d989a4bf9c5e9af163e67873641802c36234.png[/img]

We are glad to announce, that we have published closed 0.0.10 version available for testers. It is already available to download. Thanks to everyone who started the testing process! 

0.0.10 Version, what is new:

[list]
[*] Collision size of nature objects changed
[*] Collision size of enemies changed to different from player's one
[*] Enemies do not spawn near nature objects, so cannot be stuck in there
[*] Enemies now will try to find a path to the player through nature objects
[*] Now Pots are breakable to drop some Gold 
[*] Now Trees are breakable to drop some Wood
[*] Now Rocks are breakable to drop some Stone 

[*] Fixed a lot of bugs with nature objects
[*] Fixed a bug when some mobs could become immortal in very rare scenario
[*] Fixed a bug with infinite Gold crashing the game
[*] Fixed a bug with outOfBonds error when trying to spawn too many nature objects
[*] 
[*] Fixed a bug with interpolation and "waving" of nature objects.
[/list]

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/w7s8BF2Ecx

notes.title: Forsaken Valley DEVLOG: 0.0.8 version
notes.notes:
**Hello, Divine Tribe!** @everyone 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539919/d4acc18fbfda5051ccf6e28b7cbb3a331b56892a.png[/img]

We are glad to announce, that we have published closed 0.0.8 version available for testers. It is already available to download. Thanks to everyone who started the testing process! 

**0.0.8 Version, what is new:**

You can now activate Rage, Pain and Fear and their abilities.
FEAR:
When enemies surround you in drastic amounts, your FEAR will grow.
When you are Overpowered by FEAR, your Damage and Accuracy will drastically drop, but you will receive 3x bonus to Evasion and Speed, also you can unlock Shadow Mode in the future and become invisible for a short period of time.

RAGE:
When you kill enemies, your RAGE will grow.
When you are Overpowered by RAGE, your Armor and Resistance will drastically drop, but you will receive 3x bonus to Attack and Critical Chance, also you can unlock "Cleave" and "Splash" attack in the future.

PAIN:
When you receive damage, your PAIN will grow. 
When you are Overpowered by PAIN, your Agility (Evasion, Speed and Magical Resistance) will drastically drop, but you will receive 3x bonus to Armor and +30% to HP based on Max HP, also you can unlock Damage Return in the future.

Effects starting to decay if you do not maintain it for more than 10-15 seconds.

Fixed several bugs which were found in 0.0.7 version.

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/w7s8BF2Ecx

Feel free to wishlist the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597390/Forsaken_Valley/
